description: A statement is everything between two marker lines: semicolons, a block in dollar quotes and empty lines inside it are part of it. Empty lines before and after it are not sent.
script:
-- @migace script format=1
-- @migace statement

do $migace$
begin
    perform 1; perform 2;

    raise notice 'a; b';
end
$migace$


-- @migace statement
select 'a;b', $$;$$
